description: What should I build? x402 agent demand by category from public chain data (Base USDC + XRPL), with fake demand removed (testers, sellers paying themselves, loops; wallet fleets counted as one buyer) and gaps ranked (repeat buyers per seller). Rolling 7 days, refreshed every 2 h. Signed answer with sample transactions you can check, plus a dashboard link.
name: what_should_i_build
